visual_identity.core_identity: A heavy corrosive dungeon ooze that flows as an irregular low mass and destroys metal on contact.
visual_identity.silhouette: Broad spreading puddle-like mass with lobed edges, climbing tendrils, and sagging drips around obstacles.
visual_identity.body_shape: Amorphous viscous mass with no fixed anatomy; shape conforms around bars and floor openings.
visual_identity.surface: Smooth dark-associated ooze represented by strong outer contour and sparse internal gloss lines, not a filled black silhouette.

accuracy_checks: ooze is distinct from ordinary puddle
dark identity does not destroy coloring space

reference.notes: Reference material controls creature identity, anatomy, and silhouette only; Black-Ink controls the final coloring-book rendering style.
